name.description: Optional name locally unique to the parent {@link FlowGraph}. Useful for user-facing APIs such as visualization.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

parents.description:
ids of parent vertices in {@Workflow#parent} {@link FlowGraph}. NOTE: there can be multiple in the case
that several vertices in the parent {@link FlowGraph} were merged as part of translation to a single vertex
in the new graph.

timeout.description:
Timeout for the execution of the vertex. After timeout time has passed the vertex execution fails if not
successfully completed or failed already.

projection.description: Representation of {@link Transform#projection} stored as a map for access to convenient APIs.

source.description: Source type of the {@link PkgInference.Vertex.Source} vertex that this vertex ultimately descends from

interval.description:
Interval over which metrics are computed. Used for inferring {@link EvalMetricsSpec}s in
{@link PkgInference.Metadata.Collector}

actionName.description: Name of the action on the {@link Workflow.Action} from which this vertex was transformed.

originalColumnName.description:
Name of the original column which was used to add or set the new column. eg, d["a"] = round(d["b"] + 2):
originalColumnName = "b", columnName = "a"

columnName.description: Name of the column which was added or set.

title:
A {@link PkgInference.Vertex.Transform} which was produced from a {@link Data#setFieldValue} or
{@link Data#addField} {@link Workflow.Action} vertex. Preserves additional information which is required for
{@link PkgInference.Vertex.Processed#parentMetricName}.
name: PkgInference.Vertex.FieldMutation
